tools.name: search_place
tools.title: Search a place in Korea
tools.description: Search Korean places by name or keyword (e.g. '성신여자대학교') and get their coordinates, so they can be used as an origin or destination for safe-route planning.

query.description: Place name or keyword to search for, in Korean or English.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (1-15). Defaults to 5.

tools.name: find_safe_routes
tools.title: Find safe routes
tools.description: Compute up to 4 candidate routes between two coordinates in Korea and score each one for safety using nationwide police-station data and Seoul-area CCTV/security-light data. Returns safety score, distance, duration and turn-by-turn directions per route.

travelMode.description: Travel mode: WALKING for pedestrian, DRIVING for vehicle.

includeSteps.description: Include turn-by-turn steps for each route. Defaults to false.

tools.name: nearby_safety_facilities
tools.title: Count nearby safety facilities
tools.description: Count public safety infrastructure near a coordinate: police stations (nationwide) and CCTV / security lights (Seoul-area open data). Useful for judging how safe a specific spot is.

lat.description: Latitude of the point to inspect.

lng.description: Longitude of the point to inspect.

radiusMeters.description: Search radius in meters. Defaults to 500.
